action.objective: Verify Qg8+ (g7g8) as the strongest candidate with its reserved node budget, checking king safety and mate threats.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 2 gave Qg8+ the top exact score (3218). It is a queen check driving the black king, and g8 is defended by Nh8? No—the knight on h8 attacks g6/f7, not g8. The queen on g8 after K moves can grab h7. Before committing, use the reserved 2000 nodes to verify g7g8 at max depth 4, confirming no tactical refutation and that the queen is not trapped.
